comparison.objective: Open both die faces clear of a free-standing casting; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric bimanual pulling against 60 N/m spring-return sliders without disturbing the casting.
comparison.success_condition: Both faces reach marked clearance, stay level within 12 mm, and are held one second; casting disturbance is forbidden.
comparison.reason: Balanced sustained pulling against springs is not coaxial mandrel stabilization, impulsive fracture, or debris recovery.
